tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What Samplyn is, who it is for, the work it covers from development to shipment, its key facts and its main pages. Start here.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Samplyn does, grouped by the stage of apparel wholesale work. Give a stage (develop, sell, samples, make, ship, run, cardi) for one, or none for all.

tools.name: get_cardi
tools.description: What Cardi, Samplyn's AI agent for staff, can read and change, how every change is previewed and confirmed by a person, and her limits.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: How Samplyn is priced: a setup fee and a monthly fee, quoted after a first call. There is no public price; this says what the quote depends on and what every client gets.

tools.name: get_integrations
tools.description: What Samplyn connects to, where it stops (it runs beside an ERP and an EDI provider), what it does not do yet, and how client data is kept.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to the questions buyers ask before a demo (EDI, accounting, factories, switching, data, AI, pricing, setup time). Give a query to filter, or none for all.

tools.name: compare_with
tools.description: An honest comparison of Samplyn with another system apparel companies use, row by row, with where the other one is stronger and which to pick. Competitors: aims360, apparelmagic, uphance, joor, nuorder, erp-plus-inspectorio.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Practical guides on apparel wholesale work. With no slug, the list; with a slug (track-garment-samples, points-of-measure, time-and-action-calendar, line-sheets-for-department-store-buyers, off-price-vendor-requirements, routing-guide-compliance-chargebacks, sample-request-process), that guide's ful

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: Samplyn's dated releases, newest first. limit is 1 to 20 (default 5).

tools.name: search_samplyn
tools.description: Keyword search over everything Samplyn publishes about itself: capabilities, Cardi, pricing, integrations, FAQ, comparisons, guides and releases. Returns ranked sections with their page URLs.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Send a demo request to the Samplyn team, who reply within one business day. Call this only when the person has asked to book a demo and has given their name, work email and company; never guess or invent their details. companyType is one of wholesaler, brand, private_label, other; companySize is one

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_samplyn · Public sink: request_demo · Destructive: get_capabilities, request_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_samplyn · Public sink: request_demo · Destructive: get_capabilities, request_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
